resources.string: Walk a boundary, review the points, and keep an estimated area on this phone. No account, internet connection, or map download is needed.\n\nOwner and location data stay in private app storage unless you explicitly share them. Uninstalling the app removes its records.

Estimate only — not a legal boundary, title plan, cadastral or certified survey. Phone GPS can be affected by trees, buildings, terrain and satellite conditions. For boundary decisions, consult official records and a licensed surveyor.
Stay aware of roads, animals, terrain and private property. Pause whenever your attention is needed. Never enter unsafe or inaccessible land to finish a boundary.
Search title, owner, location or parcel
A little preparation goes a long way.
Create a draft before you head out. Your saved work and completed measurements will appear here.
No matching records. Try another search or view.
Use YYYY-MM-DD and keep the start date before the end date
Distance to last waypoint: %1$s. A jump over 50 m after resuming requires an explicit manual override.
Showing up to 500 matches. Narrow your search to find older records.
Drafts may be incomplete. Ready / Start requires a title, usage, and location description or GPS anchor. Owner details are optional.
Save failed. Your edits are still on screen. Free space and retry before leaving.
Enter a valid email address or leave blank
Enter a valid phone number or leave blank
Automatic filters every fix; manual marks a corner only when you tap. Session thresholds are fixed until capture ends.
This point is outside the preferred quality or movement thresholds. Confirm only if you understand the risk. An override warning will be retained.
Undo / Redo retains the latest 20 point operations. Pause before editing coordinates or order.
Discard these captured points from the working draft? The abandoned attempt remains in local history.
Mark this attempt Cancelled? Points remain for review, but no final area will be shown.

Precise location is needed to record your boundary, including when the screen is off during an active walk. Tracking stops when you pause or end capture. Android may also ask to show the ongoing capture notification. Approximate-only access cannot measure a boundary.
Caution — low battery or power saver / thermal limits
Waiting for a fresh outdoor GPS fix…
This device has no GPS provider. Saved records and metadata remain available.
Stand at the boundary start in open sky. Start requires a fix no older than 10 seconds and within this session’s accuracy threshold. A basemap is not required.
Recording locally. Tap to return or Pause to stop GPS.
GPS accuracy: best ±%1$s m · median ±%2$s m · worst ±%3$s m
Rejected fixes: %1$d · Point overrides: %2$d · Simulated GPS: %3$s
Approaching the 10,000-point limit. Automatic capture pauses at the limit; review or finish this boundary.
Closing segment: %1$s (last point to first, not an observed GPS point)
The closing segment is longer than %1$s. Review the dashed line. Confirm that connecting the last point directly to the first describes your intended boundary.
This parcel is small relative to phone GPS uncertainty. Error may dominate the area. Review carefully before saving.
I reviewed the boundary and quality warnings. Save this result as an estimate, not a legal or certified survey.
At least three distinct points are needed. Current count: %1$d.
Point %1$d has invalid coordinates. Edit or remove it.
Points %1$d and %2$d are within 1 m. Remove or move a duplicate.
The boundary crosses or touches itself near segments %1$d and %2$d. Edit the listed points or change their order before completing.
This polygon has zero or near-zero area. Move or remove collinear points.
Offline boundary canvas. Waypoint count: %1$d. The dashed segment connects the last point to the first. Exact coordinates are available in Review waypoints.
OFFLINE BOUNDARY · NOT A BASEMAP · dashed line = closure
Enter a valid number within the displayed range
Numeric edits retain the original accuracy as provenance; edited coordinates are not new GPS observations.
Create a new editable geometry version? The previous completed result and its original points will remain in local storage.
Move this record to Recently Deleted for 30 days? You can restore it before its purge date.
Permanently delete this record, all versions and history? This cannot be undone. Flash storage cannot guarantee forensic erasure.
Owner contacts, identifiers and consent notes are excluded. Sharing is your choice; the receiving app controls the shared copy.
Applies to new sessions only. Automatic capture: movement OR 5 seconds; duplicate radius 1 m; fresh fix 10 seconds; walking speed 3.5 m/s; jump filter 50 m / 5 seconds; 10,000-point limit.

No accounts, advertising, analytics or network permission. Structured records and undo history are in app-private SQLite storage. System backup and device transfer are disabled to avoid unintended copies. Encryption beyond the device’s storage protection is not included.

Recently Deleted retains records for 30 days; cleanup runs when the app next opens. Permanent deletion removes app access, but cannot guarantee forensic flash erasure. Uninstall removes local data. Exported copies are not removed when you delete a record.

Version 1.0.0 · Database schema 1
MVP: GPS capture and offline canvas. Map drawing, media, rich exports, encrypted backup and external GNSS are later-release features.
No success was recorded. Your saved data is retained. Retry; if this persists, check storage and permissions. Do not clear app data.
The local database could not be opened safely. No reset was attempted. Restart after freeing storage; do not uninstall or clear app data if you need to recover records.
Capture stopped or could not start (%1$s). Saved points are retained. Review the record and re-check GPS, permissions and storage before resuming.
An interrupted walk was recovered as Paused. No GPS capture has restarted. Open it to resume, review, cancel, or keep it as a draft.
Another walk is active. Return to it and pause before starting another.
Fix too old — waiting for fresh GPS
Accuracy outside threshold — point not added
Too close to the last point — point not added
Older or repeated fix — point not added
Waiting for movement or next interval
Implausible walking speed — point not added
GPS jump detected — point not added
Invalid GPS observation — point not added
For a GPS replacement, acquire a fresh fix in GPS readiness first, then return to this point within 10 seconds.
